info.title: e-Paperé Exams API
info.description: Same-origin JSON API. Mutations require an allowed Origin (or Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin). Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code` and `requestId`. Personalised responses are `Cache-Control: no-store`. Retry 503/429 with backoff honouring Retry-After. Save/submit idempotency: `mutationId` (UUID) scoped to the attempt; a repeated save mutation returns the original acknowledgement; a finalised attempt always returns its canonical receipt.
